request: Add the new dutch-news-explorer repository to the organization repository guide.
decision: Add one repository row and one short paragraph describing the explicit snapshot budget and the original-line search, without article text or private paths.

why.text: The organization guide lists every published explorer; a new private repository belongs there, and its one general lesson (an explicit budget for a large corpus) is useful to the next project.

evidence: The explorer repository is published privately at Dataset-explorer-tui-kit/dutch-news-explorer with a fictional VHS demo and a measured profile; its README documents 255,524 records, an explicit 480,000,000-byte / 260,000-record budget and peak RSS around 1.8 GB. The guide text names no dataset rows, hosts, paths or session details.
alternatives: Describe the corpus contents in the public guide, which would publish article-level detail the source licence does not grant here.

verification.scope: Documentation-only repository; no Go program or Go gates apply here.

checks.result: Row and paragraph read as intended; no article text, credentials or personal paths; links point at the private organization repositories.
